title: Python: the analyzer qualname for a class inside a nested function drops the intermediate function (rich RichFormatter)
description: Ordinary naming follow-up from the DEC-303 (a93) item 4 before-building read, no hold and not on the freeze path. At rich pin 3a109ccd the class RichFormatter's real lexical nesting is install (rich/pretty.py:155) -> display_hook (184) -> class RichFormatter (214, column 9, inside display_hook's try/else), while the analyzer emits the symbol qualname install.RichFormatter and drops display_hook. The census names the class install.display_hook.RichFormatter, so the measurement at dev dce9e90 scores the site as a miss until score-dev.ts matches by declaration site (GCLI-168). This task records the analyzer-side naming gap only; changing qualnames changes shipped output, so scope and timing belong to opum-doc.

acceptanceCriteria.text: A fixture shows a class defined inside a nested function of a function resolving to a qualname that states both enclosing scopes, failing before the change and passing after it
The effect on shipped output and every qualname consumer is measured and reported to opum-doc before any clear
